findings.title: Price-only excess misstates track performance

Cite the total-return view for performance. See docs/ops/total-return-view.md.

findings.title: Longer holds beat live exit buffer in replay
findings.summary: Faithful replay of logged passes with a longer exit buffer beats the live knob by ≥1%: ai_judgment: exit_confirm_screens 20 vs live 2 +25.3% over 34 passes (7 vs 41 trades; realised median hold 4.0d); rules: exit_confirm_screens 20 vs live 2 +20.8% over 32 passes (9 vs 37 trades; realised median hold 4.0d); ai_judgment_fair: exit_confirm_screens 10 vs live 2 +5.8% over 20 passes (14 vs 23 trades; realised median hold 4.0d); rules_fair: exit_confirm_screens 5 vs live 2 +7.3% over 20 passes (16 vs 24 trades; realised median hold 4.0d). Observe-only: candidate for a cold-start hold-buffer twin, not a knob edit. See docs/ops/hold-period-counterfactual.md.
